ul.li: The user can't connect to the VPN, the VPN icon in the system tray blinks.
When there is an error, the screen displays connection has timed out.

ol.li: It's because the WiFi does not work due to firewall.
The token has expired, due to which authentication fails.
There is some problem at the backend.
This error occurs because the internet connection is slow.
The Windows updates have not been installed due to which VPN does not work.

step.cmd: Disable the firewall or use hotspot.
Ask the IT administrator to issue a new token.
Click on the More Info option in the VPN icon on the system tray.Send the resulting logs to the IT administrator.
